_README: INDICATIVE PLANNING CATALOGUE - NOT A BILL, NOT A QUOTE, NOT LIVE PRICING.
Values are rounded us-east-1 on-demand list prices captured for this portfolio
project and are used only to catch obvious cost mistakes before an apply.
Always confirm with the AWS Pricing Calculator before approving spend.
free_tier_notes: Gateway VPC endpoints (S3, DynamoDB) have no hourly or data charge.
The first copy of CloudTrail management events is free.
SSE-S3 and AWS-managed KMS keys have no key charge.
VPC, subnets, route tables, internet gateways, security groups and NACLs are free.
AWS Backup vault creation is free; stored recovery points are not.

budget_example.note: See policies/budgets/budget.json for the AWS Budgets Terraform-ready shape.
